slot_expansion: For repetition R, visit task_order_by_repetition[R] in order and, for each task, visit lane_order_by_repetition[R] in order. Every expanded task/lane slot receives at most one attempt.

retry_policy.rule: Every scheduled slot produces at most one attempt. Infrastructure, budget, implementation, human, integrity, timeout and verifier outcomes remain visible. Do not reroll a failed slot.

ordering_policy.reason: Rotate both task and lane temporal position across repetitions while keeping the complete 27-slot schedule committed before any scored B1 comparative result is observed.

preregistration.timing: committed after frozen fixture qualification and before any scored B1 comparative result
preregistration.rationale: B1 reuses B0's three repetitions, zero-retry policy, frozen Agent budget and raw evidence semantics. B1 adds three matched content tasks, so the complete cohort contains 27 preregistered task/lane slots. Task order rotates independently of the inherited lane rotation to reduce systematic temporal-position bias without changing task membership or verifier authority. The selected Godot Agent Python dependency freeze is copied byte-for-byte from the preregistered qualification artifact before scoring so the same source pin cannot silently resolve to a different dependency graph.
